_doc: §wx · one forecast point per route group, placed AT SEA on the way, not at the pier or Phuket town. match = regex on route name (case-insensitive) within the same pier; a point with no match is the pier's default. hours = sailing window used for the daily summary (max wave / wind inside it). warn/risk = wave height (m) thresholds for the colour on the Boat Operation card; wind = gust (kt) that turns it amber on its own (red needs the wave). These are starting values — tune them from the history page once a season of decisions is in.
